TabsNavigation

The `m3e-tabs` component — strict per-component surface.

import M3e
import M3e.Values
These helpers are our examples, not the library

The Doc.* helpers in these examples are this docs app's own module — not part of elm-m3e (they won't resolve from a fresh install). You rarely need anything like them. The library gives you typed components (M3e.*) plus TypedHtml for standard HTML, and you never import HtmlIr: M3e.Element, M3e.Attr, M3e.Node, M3e.Values.Value and M3e.Kind.Supported / .Shared are all re-exported, so every type annotation you need is reachable from the brand. Build layout, text, and links directly from those. The genuine escapes ship with the library too, in one greppable, lint-fenced place — M3e.Unsafe (fromHtml, fromNode, recast, and customElement for a custom tag the types can't express) and M3e.Unsafe.Attributes. See Escapes.

Usage

Basic usage

M3ecomponentbuildHTML
M3e.Component.Tabs.tabs []
[ M3e.Component.Tab.tab
[ M3e.Component.Tab.selected True
, M3e.Component.Tab.for "videos"
]
[ M3e.Component.Tab.icon (M3e.Component.Icon.icon [ M3e.Component.Icon.name "videocam" ] [])
, TypedHtml.text "Video"
]
, M3e.Component.Tab.tab [ M3e.Component.Tab.for "photos" ]
[ M3e.Component.Tab.icon (M3e.Component.Icon.icon [ M3e.Component.Icon.name "photo" ] [])
, TypedHtml.text "Photos"
]
, M3e.Component.Tab.tab [ M3e.Component.Tab.for "audio" ]
[ M3e.Component.Tab.icon (M3e.Component.Icon.icon [ M3e.Component.Icon.name "music_note" ] [])
, TypedHtml.text "Audio"
]
…
, M3e.Component.Tabs.panel (M3e.Component.TabPanel.tabpanel [ M3e.Attributes.id "videos" ] [ TypedHtml.text "Videos" ])
, M3e.Component.Tabs.panel (M3e.Component.TabPanel.tabpanel [ M3e.Attributes.id "photos" ] [ TypedHtml.text "Photos" ])
, M3e.Component.Tabs.panel (M3e.Component.TabPanel.tabpanel [ M3e.Attributes.id "audio" ] [ TypedHtml.text "Audio" ])
]

component is identical to the M3e tab for this example — its content has no required slots or attributes for the component surface to enforce, so it would be a hollow duplicate of M3e. Reach for component on an example whose composition it can hold a guarantee over.

build is identical to the M3e tab for this example — its content has no required slots or attributes for the build surface to enforce, so it would be a hollow duplicate of M3e. Reach for build on an example whose composition it can hold a guarantee over.

<m3e-tabs>
…
<m3e-tab selected for="videos"><m3e-icon slot="icon" name="videocam"></m3e-icon>Video</m3e-tab>
<m3e-tab for="photos"><m3e-icon slot="icon" name="photo"></m3e-icon>Photos</m3e-tab>
<m3e-tab for="audio"><m3e-icon slot="icon" name="music_note"></m3e-icon>Audio</m3e-tab>
…
<m3e-tab-panel id="videos">Videos</m3e-tab-panel>
<m3e-tab-panel id="photos">Photos</m3e-tab-panel>
<m3e-tab-panel id="audio">Audio</m3e-tab-panel>
</m3e-tabs>

API

Types

type Is

The kind row m3e-tabs produces (open — composes into any slot naming it).

type Attrs

The closed attribute-capability row.

type Content

The kinds the default slot admits.

type NextIconSlot

The kinds the next-icon slot admits.

type PanelSlot

The kinds the panel slot admits.

type PrevIconSlot

The kinds the prev-icon slot admits.

type ChildAdmittedBy

The context demand this container injects into each child's admittedBy row.

type DisablePagination

The disablePagination values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

type HeaderPosition

The headerPosition values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

type Variant

The variant values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

Constructor

tabs : List.List (M3e.Attr M3e.Component.Tabs.Attrs msg) -> List.List (M3e.Element M3e.Component.Tabs.Content (M3e.Component.Tabs.ChildAdmittedBy childAdm) msg) -> M3e.Element (M3e.Component.Tabs.Is s) admittedBy msg

Advanced

Motion durations and state-layer opacities — raw CSS custom property overrides for the 16 transition-timing tokens and 3 interaction-state opacity tokens @m3e/web exposes.

CSS Variables

Non-color @m3e/web CSS custom properties (typescale, shape, motion, state), grouped by name hierarchy. Color tokens are in the Color section above. Type a value to override it; clear to revert. (Live default values aren't shown — Elm can't read computed CSS variables.)
